$comment: Dot.Design reusable design elements. Every "element" is a schema v2 element tree the editor inserts as a group. Drawn for this repository from shapes and paths (MIT, no external artwork). Colours are the working pair #1f2937 and #e4572e and carry brand tokens. Regenerate with scripts/dev/build-elements.php.
